description.en: Overrides the order, names and icons of DeepSeek Harness settings navigation entries using a personal profile configuration, without patching other plugins. The shipped defaults contain no rules, so the interface is unchanged until the user configures it.
description.zh: 用个人配置覆盖 DeepSeek Harness 设置导航的顺序、名称与图标，不修改其他插件源码；公共默认不含任何规则，未配置时界面不变。
